# Simple Teacher AI

> Practical, teacher-friendly AI prompts, tools, tutorials, and honest advice from a real classroom teacher.

Simple Teacher AI is written by Gregory Lebed, a classroom teacher who uses AI daily for lesson planning, parent communication, report card comments, and everyday teacher workload. The site shares copy-and-paste prompts and honest, practical guidance, no hype, no complicated tech talk.
